gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads friendly, its wide tall bowls left open like unlatched hooks. Bevellier sits above it as stencil-cut display lettering, tightly spaced and graceful, so the two feel like a crisp cut-out nameplate over an easygoing voice.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anuphan: Anuphan brings big round lowercase bowls and curves with clear gaps. Bevellier above it is flat and stencil-cut, drawn with steady pen pressure, so the two sit side by side like a sharp sign over a soft murmur.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-arimo: Flat, stencil-cut strokes of single weight, packed tight, make Bevellier instantly recognizable. And Arimo, with its tall mean line and spacious gaps in rounded glyphs, carries a long stretch of text without any fuss.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-armata: Bevellier is all stencil-cut single-weight strokes, with tight sidebearings and a wide-looking lowercase. And Armata takes over where that stops, with spacious gaps between characters and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-athiti: Graceful is the first word for Bevellier, with its flat stencil-cut strokes and squat ascenders. And Athiti follows in a plain sans, a high mean line and see-through s shapes keeping a longer passage easy going.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-atkinson-hyperlegibl: Approachable, first of all: Atkinson Hyperlegible has wide-set terminals on s and capitals that feel clipped beside its lowercase, under Bevellier's one-width stencil-cut letters. Reading runs smoothly.
Stencil cuts meet open air. Bevellier does best at crisp, pencil-consistent display lines, and Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono does its best work in its breathing counters and stretched-open spacing.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Next reads big-eyed and open, its rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. But if Bevellier shrinks small, its flat stencil-cut strokes with very close spacing lose their grace quickly.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-biryani: Approachable is how Biryani feels, with big clear eyes on every e. Bevellier does the showy part, flat stencil-cut strokes with a sophisticated air, while the plain sans keeps small counters unclogged and its modulation-free lines steady.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-blinker: Clean and friendly, Blinker holds its lines at a steady thickness. Bevellier does best at graceful, stencil-cut display with tight spacing, while the sans-serif body does its best with open apertures and tall lowercase.
